name: Groundwater Hydrology
description: Occurrence and assessment of groundwater and aquifers; theory of groundwater flow in porous media and regional groundwater flow; well hydraulics; aquifer characterisation; groundwater prospecting; water wells – design, construction, development and maintenance; managed aquifer recharge; saltwater intrusion and coastal aquifer hydraulics; groundwater modelling techniques and application of finite difference method to groundwater; groundwater flow solutions by complex analysis; sustainable groundwater management and case studies.
